purpose: Literal accounting oracle for the existing performance fixture, not inferred from engine output
offsetDefinition: Zero-based transaction offset within each 10-row block; source row = 7 + blockStart + offset
invariants: Treat Case ID as an opaque association, never as the expected oracle
Compare the exact side/sheet/source-row member set for every approved case, never only its amount or reference
No member may appear in two approved cases or in an extra fabricated case
Matches and Match Evidence must agree on case identity, status, type, totals and exact source destinations
Each original source row occurs exactly once across all Match Evidence cases, including unresolved rows
Unresolved duplicate rows must not acquire an approved status or approved source link
Required cases cannot be replaced by Needs Review to make the safety check pass
Cross-block or equal-total member swaps must fail the independent checker
